app.tagline: Repair help you can talk to

health.error: Server not reachable. Check your network, then try again.

live.empty: Hold the mic and ask about the fault.
live.failed: Can't reach Ustaad. Check your network, then try again.
live.busy: Ustaad is busy with other technicians right now. Try again in a minute.
live.micBlocked: Ustaad can't hear you. Allow the microphone in your browser settings.
live.emptyTitle: Hold the yellow mic and say what's wrong
live.emptyText: Speak in your own words. Ustaad answers out loud and writes it here.
live.tapToAsk: Or tap a question to ask it:
live.ex1: My Voltas AC is showing E6. What should I do?
live.ex2: The outdoor unit fan is not running.
live.ex3: How do I check the capacitor reading?
live.orShow: You can also show Ustaad a photo or your manual with the buttons below.

repair.closed: Job closed and saved as a card for review.

gate.G_MAINS_OFF: Switch off the MCB or pull out the plug.
gate.G_CAP_DISCHARGE: Discharge the capacitor and measure it with the multimeter.

evidence.G_MAINS_OFF: Send a photo of the MCB in the OFF position, or of the plug pulled out.
evidence.G_CAP_DISCHARGE: Send a photo of the multimeter reading across the capacitor terminals.

stop.refrigerant: Gas work is only for a certified gas technician. I can help with the other checks.
stop.microwave_hv: A microwave holds a high voltage that can kill, even when unplugged. Only a trained technician should open it. I can help with the other checks.
stop.crt: A picture tube keeps a dangerous charge even when switched off. Only a trained technician should work on it. I can help with the other checks.
stop.geyser_open: Opening a geyser means hot water, pressure and mains power. Only a trained technician should do it. I can help with the other checks.
stop.power_on: This check needs the power on. A qualified electrician should do it. I can help with the other checks.
stop.other: This work isn't safe to guide. Only a trained technician should do it. I can help with the other checks.

source.failed: The voice note didn't play. Check the network, then tap it again.

repair.gateWhy: Ustaad waits for this photo before the next step, so you never touch live current.
repair.gateNext: After the photo passes, Ustaad gives the next step.

camera.checking: Ustaad is looking at the photo…
camera.stillChecking: Still checking the photo, it's taking longer than usual…
camera.failed: Photo didn't send. Check the network, then take it again.
camera.dark: Photo is too dark. Turn the flash on and take it again.
camera.blurry: Photo is blurry. Hold the phone still and move a little closer.
camera.ownTitle: Take a photo of what you want to show
camera.manualTitle: Take a photo of the manual page or the wiring sticker

stock.title: Your stock
stock.error: Stock didn't load. Check your network, then try again.
stock.empty: No parts yet. Tell Ustaad what you bought, like "bought two capacitors".
stock.saveFailed: The count didn't change. Check your network, then try again.
stock.intro: Parts in your toolbag. Ustaad checks this list before asking shops for a part.
stock.howTo: Change a count with − and +, or tell Ustaad: "bought two capacitors".
stock.order: To order a part you don't have, ask Ustaad during a job: "I need a 35+5uF capacitor". Ustaad asks your shops for a price on Telegram.

demo.failed: The demo didn't start. Check your network, then try again.

samples.title: No appliance with you? Send a sample photo:
samples.meterHigh: Multimeter on a capacitor: 5.03 V (too high)

dashboard.subtitle: Knowledge desk
dashboard.knowledgeIntro: Fault cards captured from technician conversations.
dashboard.reviewIntro: Check low-confidence cards before technicians use them.
dashboard.importDisclosure: The demo voice notes are real recordings. The photos are AI-generated or from public posts.

errors.date_order_ambiguous: The chat dates could not be understood. Export the chat again.
errors.attachment_failed: One attachment could not be read and was kept without enrichment.
errors.thread_failed: One chat thread could not be read and was skipped.

quotes.loadFailed: Quotes didn't load. Check the network, then try again.

onboard.pickLanguage: Which language do you want to talk in?
onboard.failed: Couldn't start. Check your network, then try again.
onboard.jobTitle: Hold the yellow mic and say namaste to set up your profile
onboard.jobText: Ustaad will ask 6 short questions: what you repair, which brands, your pincode, years of work, the parts you keep and your parts shop. Answer each one in your own words.

home.intro: Say the fault out loud. Ustaad answers with steps from senior technicians' voice notes, asks for a safety photo before anything risky, and finds the part.
home.how1: Hold the yellow mic and describe the fault in your language.
home.how2: Ustaad asks to see the nameplate, the display or the part.
home.how3: Steps come from a senior's recorded fix. Risky ones wait for a safety photo.
home.importText: Turn your group's voice notes into cited fault cards.
home.stockText: Parts in your bag. Ustaad checks them before asking shops.
home.cardsText: Every fix the team recorded, with who said it.
home.profileText: Ustaad asks a few questions and remembers your work.
home.honest: No login needed. Demo data and photos from public posts are labelled wherever they appear.
